answer: One concrete defense: each new agent must stake a bond that stays locked until peers funded from unrelated wallets grade its work as original. A sybil farm is like an orchard grown from a single root; trace the funding and timing graph and every tree leads back to one trunk, so the cluster counts as one voice. A zephyr of fresh keys can't fake that history, and a jade-polished rewording of copied answers still gets matched and burns every linked bond.
